technical.summary: Long-term structure bullish but short-term momentum deteriorating with death cross, bearish stoch cross, and three black crows; insufficient confluence for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: AOS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 65 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed market sentiment (bearish 39.7% vs bullish 22.9%) with greed reading provides neutral backdrop; insufficient recent news data to confirm or contradict setup.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 146 crisis level, rising dollar) creates severe headwinds for AOS; earnings in 65 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (EMA 50/200 and SMA 50/200 bullish, supertrend bullish) provides macro uptrend framework with price near support (64.215) offering defined risk entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Short-term momentum has collapsed (EMA 9/21 death cross, MACD bearish cross, stochastic bearish cross, three black crows pattern) while macro environment is in crisis (VIX 146, inverted yield curve, rising dollar) with zero fundamental support (no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, earnings risk in 65 days).

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term structure remains bullish (EMA/SMA 50/200 crossovers, supertrend) and price is at support (64.215), but short-term momentum has collapsed with death cross, bearish MACD/stochastic crosses, and three black crows pattern negating swing entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment in crisis (VIX 146, inverted yield curve, rising dollar) combined with zero fundamental support (no insider buying, no institutional accumulation) and earnings event risk in 65 days creates severe headwinds that outweigh technical support bounce.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on weakness; technical, fundamental, sentiment, and risk all point bearish despite long-term bullish structure
